The 
first draft initiated by eng. Hatem Abd El Daim, tested by eng. Samy Shehata 
Ibrahem, accepted by eng. Hanafy Fahmy Madany: general director, approved 
by eng. Abd El-kreem Abu Zaid: head sector of High Dam Power Station, and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb: HPGC quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Stop pump and switch off the power supply.
Close the out let and inlet valves and put suitable warning boards.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet and safety shoes
Set of wrench
Alignment equipment
Grease for lubricating
Cleaning material
